description: This file defines an interface 'IRenderer' in the PhpSpreadsheet Chart Renderer namespace, specifying methods for rendering a chart to a file or stream.

classes.name: IRenderer
classes.description: Interface for chart rendering implementations, requiring a constructor accepting a Chart object and a render method to output the chart to a file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with a Chart object.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the chart to the specified filename or stream; returns true on success.
